title: Prepare a project handoff
task: Read notes/next.txt and save it as handoff.txt at lab/. Save a sorted, one-name-per-line listing of notes/ as notes-list.txt. Keep both starter notes unchanged.
hints: Run pwd and ls notes. Both reports belong at lab/, beside notes/, and the original notes must remain intact.

LC_ALL=C ls -1 notes > notes-list.txt
Then run cli-silly check.
